positive.scenario: I'm adding a new troubleshooting doc that explains how the retry queue interacts with the dead-letter handler. In the write-up I mention the config file that sets the retry threshold and the module that actually drains the queue, and I want the reader to be able to jump straight to those from the doc since it'll be viewed on GitHub. I also need to note that the queue drains roughly every 30 seconds under normal load.

negative.scenario: I'm updating the CLI's help text and inline code comments to reference the new `--dry-run` flag instead of the deprecated `--simulate` one. These references are just plain-text mentions inside comments and terminal output strings, not links to other files, so I'm making sure the flag name is spelled consistently everywhere it's typed out in the source.

adversarial.scenario: I'm building a small internal dashboard page that lists every microservice and its owning team, generated from a script that reads a manifest file. Each service name in the table should let someone click through to that service's README, and since the dashboard is meant to be browsed as a wide reference table, I was going to wrap each service link in a raw anchor tag so it pops open in a new tab without losing the visitor's place on the dashboard.
